name: Windows 10
local_hint: Put a Windows 10 ISO in the images folder. Get one from Microsoft's own download page - the licence to run it stays yours, and this mod neither supplies one nor grants one.
notes: A registry entry with no URL, which is the honest shape rather than a gap. Microsoft's download endpoints are undocumented and change often; Rufus and Ventoy do drive them, and the plan's own advice is to treat that as a convenience with a local file as the reliable path. Shipping a URL that breaks silently would be worse than shipping none. Windows 10 needs no TPM and no Secure Boot, which makes it the easier of the two to provision - but it left support in October 2025, so keep it behind the NAT-isolated network default and do not treat it as a machine you would expose. Every running Windows machine wants its own licence; cloning a template does not multiply one.
